# Developers as Decision Makers Lab

1. Download and read the [Developers as Decision Makers Lab](https://georgiadoing.github.io/CSC106-S26/Data/Developers_as_Decision-Makers.pdf)
2. Each group member should read (at elast) 1 of the following background readings
    * [Silicon Valley Triage Tool](https://georgiadoing.github.io/CSC106-S26/Data/Silicon_Valley_Triage_Tool.pdf)
    * [Economic Roundtable on the Silicon Valley Triage Tool](https://georgiadoing.github.io/CSC106-S26/Data/Economic_Roundtable_SiliconValleyTriageTool.pdf)
    * [A healthcare algorithm started cutting care](https://georgiadoing.github.io/CSC106-S26/Data/A_healthcare_algorithm_started_cutting_care_TheVerge.pdf
    * [We created poverty](https://georgiadoing.github.io/CSC106-S26/Data/We_created_poverty_VirginiaEubanks_TheGuardian.pdf)

3. Make a group copy of the [Google Doc worksheet template](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sUz_WuiO0ew0SSlC1hU7L0XYJEeF5ssuOyLST9CJNYY/edit?usp=sharing) and share it with all group members
4. Edit your worksheet as you plan, implement, test and reflect upon your team's housing algorithm
